{{Quote|Our true king has been ''silenced''.|Saw Gerrera|<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>}}
'''Ramsis Dendup''', formally stylized as '''His Royal Majesty King Ramsis Dendup''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the true [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

===Early life===
[[File:Young_Ramsis.jpg|thumb|left|King Dendup in his younger years.]]
Ramsis Dendup was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] of [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Parent/Legends|parents]]<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref> on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> He was a member of the [[King/Legends|royal]] family who ruled [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> millennia after the reign of [[Regalun Petryph]].<ref name=":4">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> At some point in [[Gender/Legends|his]] youth,<ref name="SW Front Runners" /> Dendup ascended to the position of [[King/Legends|king]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> taking the official title name of "His Royal Majesty King Ramsis Dendup".<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.46">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.46|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.46]]</ref>

During the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> Dendup was a man of advanced age who enjoyed the comforts of the crown. While living in the opulent royal residence, matters of state still weighed heavily upon him.<ref name="Ency" /> Among the paintings hanging in his throne room there were portraits from his younger days.<ref name="SW Front Runners" />

===The Clone Wars===

====Deposition====
{{Quote|I have been isolated and alone without visitors, confined to my prison. Again, the will of the people is theirs, not mine.|Ramsis Dendup, to King Rash|<ref name=":2" />}}
[[File:SanjayRash-SWE.png|thumb|[[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], the man who deposed Dendup.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|political crisis]] that had been plaguing the galaxy for a decade degenerated into an open conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> While normally allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]],<ref name=":0" /> King Dendup looked on with disapproval and dread,<ref name="Ency" /> believing in not entering the war. He regarded both sides as inherently corrupt and thought the best course of action for Onderon would be to remain unaligned,<ref name=":0" /> thinking incorrectly<ref name="SWE-Onderon rebels">{{SWE|groups|onderonrebels|Onderon rebels}}</ref> that neutrality would had spared the planet from the violent conflict.<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|king-sanjay-rash|King Sanjay Rash}}</ref>

For this, Dendup was branded an indecisive coward and ousted from the throne by those who saw opportunity for change in power.<ref name="Ency" /> At the beginning of the war, he was overthrown<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> by the young<ref name="Ency" /> [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] in a local coup secretly backed by the Separatists,<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" /> allying Onderon with them<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> through the [[Treaty of Iziz]].<ref name="Twitter Proclamation">{{Twitter|TheCloneWars|status/258992510557360128|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']]|quote=The King of Onderon has spoken. What is your take on the Onderon Rebels: Patriots or Traitors? #CloneWars|archivedate=20190722193302}}</ref> Rash was not really the true king, but a puppet to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> who branded the previous ruler as a powerless old crone.<ref name=":1" /> [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], a loyal follower of Dendup, would not tolerate Rash's Separatist-backed regime, which prompted him to join the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> They fought in the name of the deposed king, though Dendup knew nothing of their actions. He quietly lamented that his name was being used in the name of violence but accepted that the rebellion was indeed the will of the people.<ref name="Ency" /> Rash's administration imprisoned Dendup in the [[Unifar Temple/Legends|Unifar Temple]]'s garden, isolating him from any visitor.<ref name=":0" />

====First attempted liberation====
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 43-46|Liberation of Onderon}}</ref> after a series of attacks on the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the jungles and [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], Rash ordered the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] to escort his predecessor to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]. When Dendup arrived, he scolded the former king, accusing him for the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels']] increased activity. Rash insisted Dendup needed to call off the attacks. Dendup retorted that Rash was dealing with the will of the people. It was the king's responsibility to "embrace, bend, or break it," and Dendup was incapable of achieving this, as he was no longer the Omnderon's king. More frustrated, Rash reiterated Dendup had to call off the attacks, otherwise, Dendup would pay with his life. Dendup responded Rash must be the person who stopped the attacks, by ending the Separatist droid occupation.<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Saw_and_Dendup_are_caught.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Saw and King Dendup are detected and arrested in the Unifar Temple courtyard.]]
After the rebels made a few more attacks on the Separatist droids, Rash ordered Dendup to be escorted back to the throne. Again, Dendup denied involvement with the rebels and informed Rash it was the people's will that justified their actions. Fed up with Dendup's responses, Rash ordered the former king's public [[Death/Legends|execution]] in [[Yolahn Square/Legends|Yolahn Square]] the next day. Rash hoped Dendup's death would end the rebel attacks and break their morale, while he publicly denounced the former king for their crimes. After hearing the news of Dendup's planned execution, [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], who was one of the insurgent group's leaders, snuck across the city, against his sister [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela's]] orders, in hopes of rescuing Dendup. Gerrera used a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] to stealthily enter Unifar Temple's gardens, destroying an unsuspecting [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the process, before he bowed to the former king. Gerrera explained to Dendup that he and his comraded were only attacking the droids, in hopes of removing Rash from power and restoring Dendup as Onderon's true king. In response, Dendup explained how his decision to choose neither side of the war resulted in the occupation by the Separatist army. Once Gerrera informed Dendup the rebels were backed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he fired is grappling hook, expecting that would enable them both to escape. However, the Temple's one way shield was activated, which trapped both men in the Temple's gardens.<ref name=":2">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>

====Failed execution====
[[File:ElectroguillotineSoftWar.png|thumb|250px|Dendup in the electroguillotine.]]
The next day, Rash led the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|Super tactical droid]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]], as well as four [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], as they escorted King Dendup and Saw in [[Stuncuffs/Legends|chains]] to the steps of the Unifar Temple, which overlooked Yolahn Square, where Rash intended to perform the executions.<ref name=":2" /> Hundreds of Iziz citizens gathered, so they could witness the proceedings and listened to Rash's speech. Rash declared Dendup and Gerrera traitors, who deserved death by beheading. Rash ordered his MagnaGuards to prepare their [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] to behead Dendup, who had been placed into an [[Electroguillotine/Legends|electroguillotine]]. Simultaneously, the rebel [[Dono (Onderonian)/Legends|Dono]], would had reported to Steela Gerrera and [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] that Saw had been arrested, put into motion a raid to free Dendup and Saw from Separatist possession.<ref name=":2" /> If they failed, the Onderon rebellion may had died with Dendup.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Bonteri tossed [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke bombs]] at the Separatist [[Troop/Legends|troops]], causing chaos, while Steela shot the MagnaGuards with her [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], and the other Onderon rebels extracted Saw and Dendup. However, their retreat was cut short, when [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2-series super battle droids]] reinforcements surrounded Dendup and Steela's extraction team and forced her forces to surrender their weapons—much to the disgust of the Onderonian citizens, who saw the rebels as allies, and viewed Rash's Separatists as intruding invaders to their world. Once Rash regained control of the situation, he prepared to execute Dendup and Saw once more, as well as the newly incarcerated Bonteri and Steela.<ref name=":2" />

[[File:DendupFreed-TSW.jpg|left|thumb|250x250px|The rebels celebrating Dendup's liberation.]]
Kalani pushed Dendup back into the electroguillotine, while the MagnaGuards prepared their electrostaffs for the killing blow. Moments later, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]], along with the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] ran out of Unifar Temple, while Tandin ordered Rash to halt the executions. Tandin's troops freed Dendup, and the rebels escorted the former king to their [[Onderon rebel safe house/Legends|base]]. In response, Rash instructed his droids to pursue and kill Dendup and the rebels. However, the angry citizens of Iziz, prevented the droids from leaving. They barricaded the area, while they protested that Dendup was the true king of Onderon and demanded the Separatists departed Onderon.<ref name=":2" />

Later that day, Dendup entered the rebel safe house. The king questioned Tandin why he defected from the Separatists at that moment. Tandin informed Dendup it was time for a different approach. Tandin and the royal guards then pledged their allegiance to the rebels and Dendup. After Dendup said to Bonteri that his mother would be proud of him, the king stood back up. Dendup informed the rebels and the Onderonian Militia they needed to win the will of the people, before they could achieve victory for the entire planet. He also reminded his supporters that as a result, Dooku would desire his death to a far greater degree than previously.<ref name=":2" />

====War in the Highlands====
[[File:Dendup_speaks_to_the_people_of_Onderon-Tipping_Points.png|thumb|300px|Dendup addressing the people of Onderon]]
Soon after Dendup's rescue, the former king moved to a new base in the [[Onderon highlands/Legends|Onderon highlands]], alongside the rebels and the Royal Army. Later, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] deposited a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic disk]] in the middle of [[Malgan Market/Legends|Malgan Market]], which allowed Dendup to address his people, while Tano and Bonteri flew back to [[The nest/Legends|the nest]] on a [[Ruping/Legends|ruping]]. In his speech Dendup informed the Onderonian people Rash and the Separatists were spreading lies about him being the mastermind of the "terrorist movement," so he could tighten the Separatists' control on the planet. Dendup told the people his recent rescue from execution was when he first met the rebels, and he came to view the rebels as the "true sons of Onderon," with the intention of liberating their planet from the Separatists. Dendup's speech inspired the people in Malgan Market to protest the droid occupation, attacking the three B1-series battle droids who witnessed his speech.<ref name=":3">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>

While Steela and Saw argued over how the rebels should continue their attacks, Saw requested fighting in Iziz, taking the fight directly to King Rash. Steela quickly retorted they should hold their current position, since fighting door to door would cause everyone to be in danger. Dendup and Tano both agreed with Steela, with Dendup pronouncing Steela as the new commanding general of all their forces, including the Royal Army.<ref name=":3" />

Later, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] delivered several [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] to the rebels, on the behalf of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. As the droid forced began to surround the nest, Dendup was guarded by two Royal Militiamen. However, a [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunship]] soon attacked Dendup and the soldiers, forcing the trio to rush into the mountain. Seela destroyed the droid gunship, and Dendup decided he should head back outside the nest. The king ran to the edge of the cliff, wwhile Steela fired her [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], destroying both [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and in the process, one of the royal guardsmen. Moments later, Saw fired a [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launcher]] at the remaining droid gunship. The droid spun out of control, crashing directly into the nest. When Steela discovered what was transpiring, she directed Dendup to go to the ground. The droid's collision caused the cliff's edge to fragment. While the chucks of rock crumbled, Steela pushed Dendup to safety, before she attempted to jump up to the reformed ledge herself. Tano tried to save her, but Steela fell to her death after Tano was shot in the shoulder by the droid's still functioning cannon, while she was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force lifted]] Steela to safety.<ref name=":3" />

====Aftermath====
{{Quote|Remember this day, the day Onderon became free again.|Ramsis Dendup, to the people of Iziz|<ref name=":3" />}}
[[File:DendupSpeech-TippingPoints.png|thumb|left|275px|Dendup addressing the people of Onderon during Steela Gerrera's funeral.]]
After the rebels' victory in the highlands, Count Dooku lost interest in Onderon. He ordered Kalani to recall all Separatist forces and bring them to the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], as he had no interest in a prolonged war. Before Kalani left Unifar Temple's throne room, he executed Rash on Dooku's orders. Later, Dendup and the rebels returned to Iziz, where Dendup was reinstated as Onderon's king. In Yolahn Square, Dendup and the rebels held a [[Funeral of Steela Gerrera/Legends|funeral]] for Steela. During the funeral procession, Bonteri told Tano that Dendup appointed him as Onderon's new [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]. Bonteri told Tano he planned to follow in his [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|mother's]] footsteps and bring Onderon back to the Republic. The ceremony ended with Dendup telling his people to remember the day, as Onderon was free again.<ref name=":3" />

===Legacy===
Dendup's title of king of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> would be eventually held by [[Modon Kira (Galactic Civil War)|Modon Kira]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], who ruled alongside her consort [[Kira|Lady Kira]]<ref name=":5">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref> by [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Comics Companion">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A benevolent monarch,<ref name="SWE-Saw Gerrera">{{SWE|characters|sawgerrera|Saw Gerrera}}</ref> Ramsis Dendup was a patriotic [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] who fought to liberate his people during the Separatist invasion of Onderon.<ref name=":2" />

During his younger years Dendup had brown hair and a short beard.<ref name="SW Front Runners">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep503|text="Front Runners" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] he was bald and his beard was grey.<ref name=":0" /> Like other Onderonians such as [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]],<ref name="SW-The Soft War – The Clone Wars Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep504|text="The Soft War" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> the King had a personal lyra-shaped emblem [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on the back of his hands.<ref name="SW Front Runners" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RamsisDendup-characterillustration.png|thumb|250x250px|Character illustration of Ramsis Dendup by [[Chris Glenn]].]]
Ramsis Dendup first appeared in "[[Front Runners]]," the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. He was voiced by [[Barry Dennen]].<ref name=":0" />

Despite being presented as the official king of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> it was not established whatever Dendup was a member of the [[Iziz ruling family]], shown to be ruling the planet before and after Dendup's times,<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":5" /> or was a member of a separated dynasty. As the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] depicted in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' had a similar armour design to those one appeared in "[[The Soft War]]",<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":2" /> it could be the former case.
